question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` plus these SDK token-budget helpers as a stable public ContextEngine/plugin SDK contract now, or fold the signal into the broader assemble metadata design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82137?
rationale: The patch is a public plugin API and SDK export change, and the related RFC shows active maintainer-visible uncertainty about the durable assemble metadata contract.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
options.body: Approve `currentTokenCount` now, then require SDK baseline regeneration and redacted live context-engine proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into Broader RFC
options.body: Pause this PR and handle token counts together with the provenance/internal-event assemble metadata contract.

options.title: Keep Helper Private For Now
options.body: Avoid adding SDK exports until maintainers settle a smaller permanent plugin-facing token-budget API.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve `currentTokenCount` now, then require SDK baseline regeneration and redacted live context-engine proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman is assigned to this PR and has the strongest recent history on the context-engine budget and public API path.
